verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents relay scoping, token-based publish/subscribe auth and QUIC-based low-latency streaming. Nothing documents publishers sending simulcast or layered video, or the relay adapting which layer each subscriber receives based on bandwidth. The only related item is a community user asking for multi-rendition publishing, which is a feature request, not evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
